scope.strong_reference_logic: Similar sensitivity in capable M1/I4 supports a generic conditional-message association dependence; it does not isolate an ensemble-specific effect. A loss alone does not establish retrained necessity.
scope.context_value_mismatch: This creates a sender-context/value association not ordinarily seen during training. Receiver blocking is not a validated conditional sampler/exchangeability assumption for a causal/randomization test.

intervention.location: Forward pre-hooks on value_source_builder AND value_target_builder in the selected layer(s)
intervention.operation: Return concat(context[mapping,:128],context[:,128:]); never mutate the original helper context or x_j
preserved_locally: every self context and native self bypass
intervention.context_multiset: Each receiver retains exactly the same supplied incoming sender-context multiset. With identical reassignment to both deterministic builders, paired local transport-map multiset is preserved. No map-statistics collector added.
intervention.downstream_limit: Layer0 perturbation changes later hidden states, actual values and receiver states. Layer1 multiset preservation is relative to its own variant supplied live states, not factual downstream states. Both-layer effects are not additive layer importance.
intervention.N_analytic_control: Node/receiver-only helper uses concat(x_i,silu(x_i)), independent of sender-context reassignment; same actual messages/support remain. Implementation-invariant control, cited analytically; no N forwards.
intervention.transported_message_limit: Raw actual messages and local paired-map marginals are preserved at the hook; the transported-message multiset/aggregate is intentionally changed.

permutation_limits.support: Original442907-entry COO order; self entries excluded from receiver groups
permutation_limits.group_order: Receiver IDs ascending; within receiver sort by source ID, original COO record index as tie-break
permutation_limits.mapping: For each nonself incoming degree d>=2 draw one integer offset uniformly from1..d-1, then mapping[canonical_group]=roll(canonical_group,-offset)
permutation_limits.ineligible: Self and degree0/1 records map to themselves
permutation_limits.required_integrity: Mapping is a permutation of original edge records; receiver ID unchanged, eligible source node/record differs, no eligible fixed points, all self records identity; no graph symmetrizing/dedup or support change
permutation_limits.reuse: One identical mapping across every route/layer/method/fit seed
permutation_limits.distribution_limit: Restricted cyclic derangement, not uniform over all permutations; one mapping cannot estimate permutation-distribution uncertainty
permutation_limits.excluded_identity_caveat: Nonzero cyclic offsets exclude factual assignments. Conditional on supplied states, their distribution mean is Abar hbar - C/(d-1), versus factual Abar hbar + C; factual minus expected shift is d/(d-1) C (negative covariance at d=2). This one fixed mapping is not that distribution mean, unbiased independent averaging or removal of source dependence.

N_receiver_only_analytic_control: concat(x_i,silu(x_i)) contains no sender context; no redundant N trajectories
dependency: Three seed readouts of same5274 selected nodes:15822 dependent readouts; one shared fixed cyclic mapping
performance_scope: Forward-only GPU diagnostic overlaps unchanged live fits; no isolated speed claim
